nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances; written by the SHAZAMETH constructor and by _transfer.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing ERC20 allowances; rewritten by _approve, which forces the stored value to 0 for every allowance owner that is not owner().
Total token supply, initialized to 1000 * 10**12 * 10**18.
Token name string 'Shazam Token'.
Token symbol string 'SHAZAM'.
Token decimals, set to 18.
Owner address stored in Ownable; only written by the Ownable constructor and by the private, never-callable transferOwnership.
State variable initialized once with _msgSender() at deployment and used by onlyOwner instead of _owner, creating a hidden permanent privileged address that survives renounceOwnership.
Constructor of SHAZAMETH: mints the whole supply into _balances[_msgSender()] and emits Transfer from address(0).
Internal transfer routine: validates sender/recipient, moves balances with SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
Private approval routine that zeroes the allowance whenever the allowance owner (ol) is not owner(), and otherwise stores amount; emits Approval.
Public transfer that uses _msgSender() as sender.
Public transferFrom: moves tokens then decrements the allowance and re-writes it through _approve, which zeroes it for non-owner senders.
Public approve forwarding to _approve with _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
View returning _balances[account].
View returning _tTotal.
View returning _name.
View returning _symbol.
View returning _decimals.
View returning _owner.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0) but does not clear newComer, so the deployer keeps owner-only access.
Private onlyOwner function that would set _owner = newOwner; because it is private it is unreachable externally and ownership can never be transferred.
Modifier that compares the caller to newComer (captured at deployment) instead of _owner, bypassing the real ownership variable.
Context helper that returns msg.sender.
Ownable constructor that stores the deployer (_msgSender()) into _owner.
External caller address read via msg.sender/_msgSender(); the only untrusted input in this contract (block.timestamp and tx.origin are not used).
Low-level value call recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue: an external call that forwards control and ETH to an arbitrary recipient.
Low-level call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) inside Address._functionCallWithValue: forwards arbitrary calldata and ETH to an arbitrary target.
Parameter sender of _transfer, used to index _balances.
Parameter recipient of _transfer, used to index _balances.
Parameter amount of _transfer, subtracted from the sender entry and added to the recipient entry of _balances.
Parameter ol of _approve; when it differs from owner() the stored allowance is forced to 0 and Approval(...,4) is emitted.
Parameter tt (spender) of _approve, second key of _allowances.
Parameter amount of _approve, written to _allowances only in the owner branch.
Parameter recipient of transfer().
Parameter amount of transfer().
Parameter sender of transferFrom().
Parameter recipient of transferFrom().
Parameter amount of transferFrom(), used both for the token move and the allowance subtraction.
Parameter spender of approve().
Parameter amount of approve().
Parameter owner of allowance().
Parameter spender of allowance().
Parameter account of balanceOf().
Parameter newOwner of the private transferOwnership(), which is never reachable.
Parameter recipient of Address.sendValue, target of the low-level value call.
Parameter amount of Address.sendValue, ETH value forwarded in the low-level call.
Parameter target of Address._functionCallWithValue, address executed with arbitrary calldata.
Parameter data forwarded verbatim to the target of the low-level call.
Parameter weiValue forwarded together with the low-level call.
Local variable msgSender in the Ownable constructor holding the result of _msgSender().
Local variable success holding the boolean result of the low-level call in Address._functionCallWithValue and controlling the revert path.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside Context._msgSender and returned to every caller of the helper.
SHAZAMETH constructor uses _msgSender() as the address credited with the initial supply.
constructor reads _tTotal when minting the supply.
constructor writes _balances[_msgSender()] = _tTotal.
Ownable constructor uses _msgSender() as the initial owner.
Ownable constructor writes the deployer address into _owner.
newComer is set once from _msgSender() at deployment, creating a permanent privileged address independent of _owner.
onlyOwner compares the caller against newComer instead of _owner.
The modifier checks msg.sender against the deployment-time newComer value.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership, and the gate stays open for newComer after _owner is zeroed.
onlyOwner gates the private transferOwnership function.
transferOwnership assigns newOwner to _owner, but being private it can never be reached, so ownership is frozen.
owner() returns _owner.
_approve compares the allowance owner argument against owner() and zeroes the allowance for all other callers.
approve forwards to _approve.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
transferFrom rewrites the allowance through _approve after moving the tokens.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender.
transfer calls _transfer.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for both sender and recipient.
_approve writes _allowances, storing 0 when the allowance owner is not owner().
allowance reads _allowances.
balanceOf reads _balances.
amount parameter is subtracted from the sender balance and added to the recipient balance via SafeMath.
sender parameter indexes _balances and is checked against address(0).
recipient parameter indexes _balances and is checked against address(0).
ol selects whose allowance is modified and decides whether the allowance is forced to 0.
tt is the spender key of the allowance entry.
amount is stored only in the owner() branch, otherwise the allowance is set to 0 regardless of the argument.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer from transfer().
amount parameter flows into _transfer from transfer().
sender parameter flows into _transfer and _approve from transferFrom().
recipient parameter flows into _transfer from transferFrom().
amount parameter is used for both the token move and the allowance subtraction in transferFrom().
spender parameter flows into _approve from approve().
amount parameter flows into _approve from approve().
owner parameter is the first key read from _allowances.
spender parameter is the second key read from _allowances.
account parameter is the key read from _balances.
newOwner would replace _owner, but the private function is unreachable so this dataflow never executes.
recipient of the low-level value call receives execution control and can re-enter calling contracts.
amount of ETH is forwarded to the recipient inside the external call before any state settles.
target of the low-level call is an arbitrary address that executes attacker-supplied calldata.
data is forwarded verbatim to the target, enabling arbitrary external interaction.
weiValue is forwarded with the external call, handing both value and control to the target.
local msgSender captured in the Ownable constructor is written into _owner.
the success flag of the low-level call determines whether returndata is bubbled or the call reverts.
the recipient invoked by the low-level value call can re-enter the token state-mutation logic (_transfer) while the outer call is still running.
the arbitrary target of the low-level call can call back into the token state-mutation logic (_transfer) before the caller completes.
